pooling_note: per-text embedding (batch=1), batch-independent. The pre-fix batch path was not reproducible: the same two question texts scored 0.7661 (batch=1), 0.7727 (batch=2, pipeline with pooling/normalize), 0.8043 (batch=54, batched manual pooling) and 0.8085 (batch=54, per-text). The 0.038 spread exceeded the 0.0043 threshold margin, so every score and duplicate verdict depended on batch composition. Fixed in tools/cosine.cjs embed() by embedding one text per forward pass (nothing to pad, attention_mask is all-ones).

The pipeline figure is a separate 2-text call with { pooling: 'mean', normalize: true }; the plain pipeline() call with no options returns a 3D token matrix, which cannot be cosined directly.

threshold_warning: 0.80 < background_max. New pairs > 0.80 will be auto-rejected. L5c (intra-batch manual review) required before accepting new batches.
calibration_note: Recalibrated after the batch-independence fix (per-text embedding). ug_003~ug_004 dropped out of the whitelist (0.7661); ug_005~ug_006 (0.8085) stays whitelisted. fm_002~fm_003 was removed from known_exceptions after the S2b stem rewrites dropped it below 0.80. Threshold unchanged at 0.80 by explicit decision.
justification: The pre-fix embed() scored a padded batch, so a text's vector depended on the longest text beside it and the measured maximum was a property of batch composition, not of the corpus. per-text embedding (batch=1) removes padding entirely and is reproducible: ug_003~ug_004 returns 0.7661 in a 2-question file, inside the 12-question pending batch and inside the 54-question bank. On the recalibrated 54-question bank the maximum is ug_005~ug_006 = 0.8085 with 2 pairs above 0.80, 2 above 0.78, 5 above 0.75 and 21 above 0.70. Under the old batched embedding the same bank reported 1 pair above 0.80 (ug_003~ug_004 = 0.8043).
note: The cosine threshold remains 0.80 by explicit decision and was not changed. Because background_max 0.8085 now exceeds it, any future batch containing a pair at that similarity will be auto-rejected unless it is listed in known_exceptions.
caveat: all-MiniLM-L6-v2 is an English model; cosine scores on Russian text are compressed (paraphrase 0.49 vs unrelated 0.42 in a short probe), so the dynamic range is much narrower than for English. This is why topically-related but distinct questions can reach 0.80.
